803-2239-7507-8043.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
803-2239-7507-8043.description:
Cast Kindred Charge for free due to Vision, choosing a creature type granted by Arcane Adaptation, creating a token copy of each creature you control with haste, and setting up a delayed exile trigger.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Ardent Elementalist token enters, it triggers, returning Kindred Charge from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

323-1981-2415-8250.description:
Activate Scarland Thrinax by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Falkenrath Noble and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Falkenrath Noble trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve Scarland Thrinax's ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1453-2292-4694-7306.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
1453-2292-4694-7306.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Arwen.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, scrying 1.
Repeat from step 1.

1479-2841-7892-8102.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Windswept Heath.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
1479-2841-7892-8102.description:
Fetch a land using Windswept Heath.
When the fetched land enters, Thranduil the Strategist and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Thranduil the Strategist trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Thranduil the Strategist from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Thranduil the Strategist triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

2835-6249-6495--5.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, it and Fecundity trigger.
Resolve the Fecundity trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the persist creature's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters the battlefield, Olivia triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature and causing you to discard a card.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
2835-6249-6495--5.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

6247-6249-8095--5.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, it and High-Society Hunter trigger.
Resolve the High-Society Hunter trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the persist creature's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters the battlefield, Olivia triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature and causing you to discard a card.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

360-728-1981-2415.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
360-728-1981-2415.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Soul Warden triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

1753-3259-7917--185.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1753-3259-7917--185.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Seluma, triggering both Breath of Fury and Seluma.
Resolve the Seluma trigger, returning an Angel from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Angel returned in step 2, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.
1753-3259-7917--185.notes: One of the two additional Angels must be on the battlefield with the other in your graveyard. If both chosen Angels have haste, then Samut can be omitted.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

676-955-3259.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
676-955-3259.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Magnus the Red, triggering Breath of Fury and Magnus the Red.
Resolve the Magnus the Red trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

4943-7070-7444.description:
Activate Lancers en-Kor by paying {0}, targeting itself.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending Lancers en-Kor.
The Lancers en-Kor ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast Lancers en-Kor from exile by paying {0} due to Advanced Reconstruction.
Repeat.

3258-3557-7417.description:
If Beacon of Tomorrows is in your library, cast a copy of Wild Idea by paying {3}{U}{R}, searching your library for Beacon of Tomorrows and putting it into your hand.
If Sanar doesn't have summoning sickness, activate it by tapping it, creating a Treasure token. Then, activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Cast Beacon of Tomorrows by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and shuffle Beacon of Tomorrows into your library.
Blink Sanar using Brago. It'll enter prepared due to its static effect.
Repeat each turn.
3258-3557-7417.notes: If Beacon of Tomorrows is in your hand to start, you can skip step 1 the first iteration and save {3}{U}{R} during that iteration. If Sanar starts with summoning sickness, you need an additional {U} the first iteration.

628-5007-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Morselhoarder.
When Morselhoarder dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability
Repeat.
628-5007-5147.notes: The remaining -1/-1 counter can be removed each loop to gain infinite colored mana.

2440-6737-7109-7297.description:
Cast Trusty Boomerang by paying {1}.
When Trusty Boomerang enters, Barret's triggers, creating a 2/2 Rebel creature token.
When the Rebel enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Rebel you control.
Activate Trusty Boomerang's equip ability by paying {1}, attaching it to the Rebel token.
Activate the Rebel by paying {1} and tapping it, tapping a creature and returning Trusty Boomerang from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
2440-6737-7109-7297.notes: The cost can be reduced by {1} if you control another Rebel.

140-4484-4871-5256-5643.easyPrerequisites:
A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
You've cast a spell this turn.
140-4484-4871-5256-5643.notablePrerequisites: You've lost X or more life this turn.
140-4484-4871-5256-5643.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {B}{B}.
Geralf's first ability triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie Rogue creature token.
When the Zombie Rogue enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers,  putting a number of +1/+1 counters on the Zombie Rogue equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
When Ebondeath enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
Activate Altar of Dementia twice by sacrificing the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath.
When the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve both Altar of Dementia abilities.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.
140-4484-4871-5256-5643.notes: This combo will steadily put more +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath and the Zombie Rogue token, eventually resulting in an infinite number of them.

1849-2366-3322-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
1849-2366-3322-5702.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Nikya of the Old Ways triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

147-1638-2060-7061.description:
Cast Quandrix Command by paying its mana cost, choosing its first and third modes.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, copying Quandrix Command, with the copy's first mode targeting Dualcaster Mage and the copy's third mode targeting Crystalline Crawler.
Resolve the copy of Quandrix Command, returning Dualcaster Mage from the battlefield to your hand and putting four +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler due to Solid Ground.
Holding priority, activate Crystalline Crawler three times by removing four +1/+1 counters from it, adding {2}{U}{U}.
Repeat from step 2.

2034-5276-6767.description:
Cast Leonin Relic-Warder by paying {W}{W}.
When Leonin Relic-Warder enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Rescue Skiff.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Leonin Relic-Warder.
When Leonin Relic-Warder dies, its second ability triggers, returning Rescue Skiff from exile to the battlefield.
When Rescue Skiff enters, it triggers, returning Leonin Relic-Warder from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Leonin Relic-Warder enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Rescue Skiff.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2921-5007-6972.description:
If Morselhoarder has any -1/-1 counters on it, activate it by removing a -1/-1 counter from it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat step 1 as necessary until Morselhoarder has no -1/-1 counters on it.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Morselhoarder.
When Morselhoarder dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

132-5200-5527.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may attach Sword of the Paruns to any other creature(s) to untap them.

1432-3784-6657.description:
Activate Ioreth of the Healing House by tapping it, targeting Gogo.
Holding priority, activate Vhal by tapping it, adding at least {C}{C}{C}{C}{C} that cannot be spent to cast spells from your hand.
Activate Gogo by paying {4} and tapping it, copying the Ioreth of the Healing House ability, targeting Gogo and Vhal.
Resolve both copies of the Ioreth of the Healing House abilities, untapping Gogo and Vhal.
Repeat from step 2.
1432-3784-6657.notes: You can do this combo using Ioreth's second ability instead. This only requires Vhal to have 3 toughness, but will only result in you untapping legendary creatures as opposed to permanents.

1115-1563-2457-2557.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate the Insects by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.

1594-3705-4050-5997.description:
Cast Squee from your graveyard or from exile by paying {R}{R}.
Iraxxa triggers, creating a 2/2 Alien Warrior creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing Squee and the Alien Warrior, adding {R}{R}.
Repeat.

116-283-3680.description:
Activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it, targeting Stunt Double.
Illusionist's Bracers triggers, copying Kiora's Follower's ability.
Resolve both Kiora's Follower abilities, untapping Stunt Double and another permanent you control.
Activate Stunt Double by tapping it, untapping Kiora's Follower.
Repeat.

215-729-2026-2404.notablePrerequisites:
Voyaging Satyr does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least five other creatures.
215-729-2026-2404.description:
Activate Gaea's Cradle by tapping it, adding at least eight {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Great Oak Guardian to your hand.
Cast Great Oak Guardian by paying {5}{G}.
When Great Oak Guardian enters, it triggers itself, untapping all creatures you control and giving them +2/+2 until end of turn.
Activate Voyaging Satyr by tapping it, untapping Gaea's Cradle.
Repeat.
If you control nine or more creatures, this combo will net infinite green mana, which you then may activate Temur Sabertooth any number of times and recast any creatures castable with green mana any number of times, effectively "blinking" your green creatures any number of times.
You may also activate Voyaging Satyr any number of times.

1692-2103-3662.manaNeeded: {3}{U}{U}{R} available the first turn, with {1}{R}{R} each extra turn
1692-2103-3662.notablePrerequisites: Helm of the Host attached to Izzet Chemister.
1692-2103-3662.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying {3}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your combat phase, Helm of the Host triggers, creating a token copy of Izzet Chemister.
Activate the Izzet Chemister token's first ability by paying {R} and tapping it, exiling Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard.
On your next turn, activate the Izzet Chemister token's last ability by paying {1}{R}, tapping it, and sacrificing it, casting the exiled spell without paying its mana cost.
Resolve that spell, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat from step 2.

67-2438-4881.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Reveillark.
When Reveillark dies, it triggers, returning Activated Sleeper from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Reveillark.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Activated Sleeper.
When Activated Sleeper dies, it triggers, returning Activated Sleeper from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Reveillark.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 3.

235-331-1811.notablePrerequisites:
You have an instant or sorcery card in hand that can target a single creature and deal damage to it.
You have enough mana to pay for the instant or sorcery.
235-331-1811.description:
Cast the instant or sorcery spell by paying its mana cost, targeting Zada.
Zada triggers, copying the spell for each other creature you control the spell could target, ensuring that Imodane's copy is put onto the stack first.
Resolve the first copy, dealing twice the listed amount of damage to the targeted creature.
Imodane triggers, dealing four times the listed amount of damage to each opponent.
Repeat from step 3 for each remaining copy.

1061-1379-4331-4785.manaNeeded: {6}{U}{U}{U} each odd-numbered turn, with {1}{U} available each even-numbered turn
1061-1379-4331-4785.notablePrerequisites: You control at least eight permanents and/or have the city's blessing.
1061-1379-4331-4785.description:
Cast Timestream Navigator by paying {1}{U}.
Holding priority, activate Drafna's second ability by paying {3} and tapping it, copying Timestream Navigator.
When the Timestream Navigators enter the battlefield, if you do not have the city's blessing, they trigger, giving you the city's blessing.
Activate Dynaheir by tapping it, copying the next ability you activate this turn that costs four or more mana to activate.
Activate the Timestream Navigator token by paying {2}{U}{U}, tapping it and putting it on the bottom of your library.
Dynaheir triggers, copying Timestream Navigator's ability.
Resolve both Timestream Navigator abilities, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Move to your first extra turn.
Activate Drafna's first ability by paying {1}{U}, returning the nontoken Timestream Navigator from the battlefield to your hand.
Move to your second extra turn.
Repeat.

1651-2633-4659-4868-4883.notablePrerequisites: You've cast three or more instants and/or sorceries this turn.
1651-2633-4659-4868-4883.description:
Activate Urabrask by paying {R}, exiling it and returning it to the battlefield as The Great Work.
As The Great Work enters the battlefield, a lore counter is placed on it.
The Great Work triggers, dealing three damage to an opponent and each creature they control.
Activate Contagion Clasp by paying {4} and tapping it, putting two lore counters on The Great Work.
The Great Work's second and third abilities trigger.
Resolve the first Great Work trigger, creating three Treasure tokens.
Resolve the second Great Work trigger, allowing you to cast instants and sorceries from graveyards this turn, and then exiling The Great Work and returning it to the battlefield as Urabrask.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping two Treasures, untapping Contagion Clasp.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks twice by sacrificing the two tapped Treasures, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate the final Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Repeat.

1335-3062-4929.notablePrerequisites: Marath has at least two +1/+1 counters on it.
1335-3062-4929.description:
Activate Marath by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, giving itself two +1/+1 counters.
Activate Marath by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, giving Cryptic Trilobite two +1/+1 counters.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Repeat for infinite +1/+1 counters on Cryptic Trilobite.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Activate Marath's ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, giving itself two +1/+1 counters.
Repeat from step 5 to get infinite {C} that can only be spent to activate abilities and to put infinite +1/+1 counters on Marath, with which you can use to activate Marath's ability infinite times.

1987-2556-3075-4792.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two experience counters.
1987-2556-3075-4792.description:
Activate Paradise Plume by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Paradise Plume and Mnemonic Wall, blinking them as well as triggering Paradise Plume to gain you 1 life.
When Mnemonic Wall enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
When Paradise Plume enters the battlefield, choose "blue".
Repeat.
